d:
In conversation with Eva Malhotra, Mexican-based visual artist, and Shri Anjani Kumar Singh, Director General, Bihar Museum, as they speak about Call to the Mystic, its themes, Eva’s works and her creative process.
The exhibition is on view in the Multipurpose Hall, Bihar Museum Patna till 28th February 2026.
Come visit the exhibition and experience art in a new way.
For more information, please visit our website.
